slides.heading: Meet <accent>Gemini Embedding 2</accent>
slides.caption: Google's first natively multimodal embedding model. Released March 10, 2026.

slides.text:
Google just dropped <accent>Gemini Embedding 2</accent> -- the first embedding model that maps text, images, video, audio, and documents into a <accent>single unified space</accent>.

No more separate pipelines.
No more converting everything to text.

One model. Five modalities. One vector space.

slides.heading: 5 Modalities, <accent>One Space</accent>
items: Images -- up to 6 per request (PNG, JPEG)
Audio -- native ingestion, no transcription needed
Documents -- PDFs up to 6 pages, visual + text

slides.heading: Build It in <accent>5 Lines</accent>
slides.body:
Embed text, images, and audio
in a single API call.

No preprocessing.
No separate models.
Just pass it in.

slides.heading: Multimodal <accent>RAG Flow</accent>
elements: Ingest: Text + Images + Audio + Video + PDFs
Generate: Gemini Pro answers with context

slides.heading: Why <accent>Matryoshka</accent> Matters
slides.body:
- Default output: 3,072 dimensions
- Scale down to 1,536 or 768 dynamically
- Smaller = faster search, lower storage cost
- Larger = higher accuracy
- Same model, flexible tradeoff
- No retraining needed

slides.heading: Plug Into Your <accent>Stack</accent>
slides.body:
- LangChain + LlamaIndex
- Haystack
- Weaviate, Qdrant, ChromaDB
- Google Vector Search
- BigQuery, Pinecone
- Vertex AI RAG Engine

Model ID: gemini-embedding-2-preview
Available via Gemini API + Vertex AI

slides.text: The best RAG pipelines don't convert everything to text first. They understand each modality natively.

slides.heading: Key <accent>Takeaway</accent>
slides.body:
- One embedding model for ALL modalities
- Interleaved input (image + text in one call)
- Matryoshka dimensions (3072 / 1536 / 768)
- 8 task types for optimized retrieval
- Drop-in replacement for text-only embeddings
- RAG just got multimodal. For real.
